temporal_order: Post-outcome exploratory design: source-level mammal GPS contrasts and cohort-average coarse ERA5 environment effects already known. Pairwise original GPS response × pairwise environment association and within-animal-year correlations have not yet been evaluated for this route. This contract is not an external preregistration or causal specification.
scientific_question: Within EACH of six already qualified public Movebank mammal cohorts, when the same marked animal visits comparable sunlit-daylength periods, do date-pair differences in regional temperature or antecedent precipitation-minus-ET0 associate with the observed reallocation of its NIGHT relative to DAY GPS displacement? Does the direction generalize even within a cohort or remain heterogeneous?
source_frame: Exact original six successful ORIGINAL MD5-pinned bitstreams from first three-source Movebank pilot and eight-source extension, with all four other source MD5 mismatches and the insufficient moose separately frozen; do not rescue/reclassify them.
original_first_gps: scripts/movebank_regional_climate_link_20261019.py locked_pairs() computes ORIGINAL solar-matched relative NIGHT-vs-DAY GPS log1p(km/h) e per individually paired date and equal-animal original group mean, under 30–120min steps, 3+ day/night steps, 5min daylength, 30-day source date separation, >=10 paired dates/animal-year and per-zone sampling ratio 0.5–2. No refits.
source_group_first_environment: First 3 cohort matched ERA5 CI 39203998039; other three first successful original GPS/ERA5 CI 39214116116. Current weather results are source-specific coarse fixed public grids, not each animal's experienced habitat temperature.
environment: Open-Meteo historical ERA5 models=era5 and exact original source-fixed public coarse region, standard offset timezone; prior 30d P−ET0 sum and target-date daily mean 2m temperature. Original source API response SHA256 sequence must be identical to first published source, otherwise source hold before new result; no alternative model, season window, site or weather scaling.

estimand.unit: Original one-to-one matched rising/falling date-pair e, nested within individual×solstice/year within ONE GPS archive; never event-level independent mammal replicates.
estimand.e: falling minus rising [log1p median NIGHT km/h − log1p median DAY km/h] from original locked_pairs, without changing its day/time filters.
estimand.X_T: ERA5 coarse population-region daily mean air temp falling date minus rising date (°C).
estimand.X_W: ERA5 original source region prior 30d summed P-ET0 falling date minus rising date (mm).
estimand.per_year: Within ORIGINAL marked animal×calendar year only, rank-Spearman rho(e,ΔT), rho(e,ΔP−ET0), counting each source pair one time. This is an association with geographic climate season, not an animal microclimate slope.
estimand.minimum_source_support: At least 10 ORIGINAL retained one-to-one date pairs AND >=80% of ORIGINAL paired dates weather-source qualified, >=8 complete finite independent date-pair observations for each predictor, >=4 distinct source predictor and response values. Keep undefined and low-support individual years; do not adjust thresholds after outcome.
estimand.per_individual: Equal mean of source-valid year-specific rhos, ignoring undefined years only for that predictor. A marked animal enters each source one time even if contributing multiple years.
estimand.per_source: Descriptive source mean and median individual rho; individual positive/negative/zero directions; distinct animals and total matched source pair counts; leave-one-individual-out mean min-max (NOT CI). Source-level descriptive estimate only if >=5 source animals have finite rho for a predictor. All six sources, all holds, negatives, zeros, undefined retained.
estimand.outcome_reporting: Both original source_group_e and original coarse-ERA5 source_group_ΔT,ΔW must replay exactly before reporting new association, preserving population-level means; individual-year nested result counts aggregate only, never an individual effect/location/time export.
estimand.no_statistical_tests: No pairwise p-values, no six-source meta-regression, no confidence intervals from shared-region weather dates; effective replicates number of independently recruited cohorts (max six), and shared weather per original source means correlated animal observations.
estimand.no_response_tuning: No new dates, no after-sign source exclusion, no animal identity reconstruction/export, no geographic coordinates from raw GPS, no new photoperiod bins or weather exposure location, no alternative rolling history, no selection of 'best' predictor. Compute both registered T and water unconditionally.

interpretation_limits: Within-animal annual rank correlation reduces between-source species/geography confounding but cannot remove common seasonal trends, physiology, phase, reproduction, GPS observation timing, animal range use or autocorrelated date pairs.

One weather pixel shared by all source animals creates strong covariate pseudoreplication; an individual Spearman coefficient is descriptive evidence of observations, not an independently manipulated heat exposure.
Coarse P−ET0 is a modeled hydroclimatic proxy, not measured soil water, biomass or vegetation greenness.
Different species in different places preclude interpreting differences between cohort rho as species traits or causal thermal sensitivity.
An individual's GPS minimum straight-line displacement is not behavioral activity time; camera PHOTO and duck reported instantaneous speed are different estimands and not pooled.
If all six cohorts have insufficient within-year weather variation/response ties, the valid outcome is explicit insufficient support, not a negative ecological law.

Most valuable non-obvious ecological result would be conditional within-cohort response heterogeneity or a stable cross-source sign on the SAME endpoint, not a post-hoc maximum effect from multiple predictor choices.
source_artifact_policy: Write only anonymous by-cohort aggregate n and finite/undefined rho indicators. No raw GPS CSV, animal IDs, date pairs, individual effects, or source precise coordinates included in committed file/artifacts.
future: If identifiable, next deliberately source-held-out ecological validation or independently repeated populations of same species. Do not claim universality based on n=197 GPS tags or six convenience cohorts.
